evidence_items.title: CTTL general ontology test pass for KUAVO
evidence_items.claim: CTTL Terminal Labs tested Leju KUAVO and it passed the general ontology test; the robot weighs about 45kg, has 26 DoF, pace speed up to 4.6km/h, continuous jumps over 20cm, and can perform task operations, planning/navigation, complex terrain autonomous walking, and continuous jumping.
evidence_items.notes: Independent government-affiliated certification lab (CAICT/CTTL). Test results are independent of company claims.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Strong independent verification of mobility, speed, jumping, and basic autonomy capabilities.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: Leju KUAVO (Chinese "Kuafu") large-size highly dynamic humanoid robot, weighing about 45kg, 26 degrees of freedom of the whole body, its pace speed can reach up to 4.6km/h, fast continuous jump height of more than 20cm, at this stage the robot has been able to achieve task operations, planning and navigation, complex terrain autonomous walking, continuous continuous jumping and other functions.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Independent test report; exact test conditions and scoring not published.

evidence_items.arena_relevance: Provides a purchase path and conflicting weight spec.
evidence_items.source_location: Robotics Center product page, Key Specifications
evidence_items.verification_notes: Net weight conflicts with CTTL's 45 kg; conflict noted in researcher_notes.

evidence_items.title: Leju IPO filing sales data
evidence_items.claim: Leju's full-size Kuavo series generated 178 million yuan in sales in 2025, accounting for 68.86% of total revenue, and sold 577 units cumulatively in 2025; company revenue was 258 million yuan with 118.68% three-year CAGR.
evidence_items.notes: Company-reported figures from IPO filing, reported by reputable media Gasgoo.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Demonstrates commercial sales volume and revenue, though units may be to research/industrial customers.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: In 2025, its full-size Kuavo series generated 178 million yuan in sales—a roughly 12-fold jump—accounting for 68.86% of total revenue. Accordingly, Leju sold 577 units of the Kuavo series cumulatively in 2025, ranking among the top globally.
evidence_items.verification_notes: Numbers originate from IPO filing; no independent audit in media report.

evidence_items.title: KUAVO-MY open platform specs
evidence_items.claim: Leju Robotics' KUAVO-MY is an open platform for general embodied intelligence, 1.4 m tall with more than 40 DoF, suitable for developers and industrial applications; weight not listed.
evidence_items.notes: Media reporting company claims; KUAVO-MY is a variant, not base KUAVO.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Provides height and DoF for a newer variant.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: KUAVO-MY is an 'open platform' for general embodied intelligence, suitable for both developers and industrial applications, according to Leju. It stands 1.4 m (4 ft., 9.8 in.) tall and has more than 40 DoF, but the company did not list its weight.
evidence_items.source_location: The Robot Report article, Leju builds an 'open platform' section
evidence_items.verification_notes: Company spec via media; not independently measured.

evidence_items.title: Kuavo torchbearer at National Games
evidence_items.claim: Kuavo served as torchbearer at China's 15th National Games, completing ~100m, gripping a 1.6kg torch, and operators directed every motion via 5G-A remote control.
evidence_items.notes: Reputable media report of a public event; demonstration was teleoperated.
evidence_items.arena_relevance: Shows real-world mobility and basic grasping, but not autonomy.
evidence_items.supporting_excerpt: This allowed operators in a control room to direct Kuavo’s every motion – from starting and running to waving and transferring the torch – as it moved through the crowd.
evidence_items.source_location: Robotics & Automation News article, A technological triumph section
evidence_items.verification_notes: Article confirms remote real-time control, so teleoperation is disclosed.

researcher_notes.short_verdict_for_arena: Leju Kuavo has independent CTTL certification for mobility (4.6 km/h, 20cm jumps, 26 DoF) and reported sales of 577 units in 2025, but most capability demos are title-only videos or a teleoperated torchbearer event; autonomy and manipulation evidence remain weak.
strongest_positive_evidence: CTTL independent test pass for mobility specs, autonomous walking, and jumping (source_001).
577 Kuavo units sold in 2025 per IPO filing; 178 million yuan revenue (source_003).
Public torchbearer event showing 100m walk with torch, albeit teleoperated (source_005).
Official video title indicating parcel delivery (source_007).
weakest_or_missing_evidence: No autonomous manipulation or task execution evidence.
No runtime, battery, or reliability metrics.
No hand, sensor, or compute specifications.
Video sources provide only titles without transcripts.
conflicting_claims: Weight: 45 kg (CTTL) vs 60 kg (Robotics Center listing).

KUAVO-MY height 1.4 m with >40 DoF (variant) differs from base KUAVO 26 DoF.
do_not_overclaim: Do not credit autonomous torchbearer performance; it was explicitly teleoperated.
Do not credit household or factory tasks from title-only videos as verified.

arena_prompt_summary.one_paragraph_summary: Leju Kuavo is a family of full-size biped humanoids from Leju Robotics, with base KUAVO independently tested by CTTL at 45 kg, 26 DoF, 4.6 km/h pace, and 20cm jumps; KUAVO-MY variant is 1.4 m with >40 DoF. Leju's IPO filing reports 577 Kuavo units sold in 2025 for 178 million yuan. A public torchbearer event demonstrated 100m torch carrying and handover, but was explicitly teleoperated. Several YouTube titles suggest parcel delivery, household help, modular hands, and FAW factory work, but lack transcripts. No autonomous manipulation, runtime, battery, sensor, or hand specs were found in reviewed sources.
strongest_evidence: CTTL independent test: 4.6 km/h pace, 20cm jumps, 26 DoF, autonomous walking (leju-kuavo_evidence_001).
577 units sold and 178M yuan revenue from IPO filing (leju-kuavo_evidence_003).
Teleoperated torchbearer event with 1.6kg torch over 100m (leju-kuavo_evidence_005).
weakest_evidence: No autonomous task execution or manipulation verified.
No price, runtime, battery, hand/sensor specs.
Video titles only for factory/household/parcel claims.

$50,000 price unless confirmed outside provided sources.
